parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT max(call_date)::date FROM calls) AS latest_call,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM calls WHERE call_date > now() - interval '24 hours') AS calls_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM signals WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS signals_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM run_logs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS runs_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM inbox WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM inbox WHERE status = 'pending' AND received_at < now() - interval '2 hours') AS stuck;
